description: Defines the AudioSource class for audio input handling in Android, including constructors, methods for control and configuration, and internal state management.

classes.name: AudioSource
classes.description: A class for managing audio input sources, supporting configuration, control, and callback handling.

methods.name: AudioSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing AudioSource with attributes, attribution source, sample rates, device, and microphone parameters.

methods.name: AudioSource (legacy constructor)
methods.description: Legacy constructor for vendor dependencies, including package name, UID, PID, and other parameters.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the AudioSource was initialized correctly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts audio capture with optional parameters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops audio capture and resets internal state.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the media format of the audio source.

methods.name: getMaxAmplitude
methods.description: Returns the maximum amplitude since last call.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads audio data into a buffer with optional read options.

methods.name: setStopTimeUs
methods.description: Sets a stop time for audio capture in microseconds.

methods.name: signalBufferReturned
methods.description: Signals that a media buffer has been returned.

methods.name: setInputDevice
methods.description: Sets the input device for audio capture.

methods.name: getRoutedDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID currently routed.

methods.name: addAudioDeviceCallback
methods.description: Adds a callback for audio device events.

methods.name: removeAudioDeviceCallback
methods.description: Removes a previously added audio device callback.

methods.name: getActiveMicrophones
methods.description: Retrieves information about active microphones.

methods.name: setPreferredMicrophoneDirection
methods.description: Sets preferred microphone direction.

methods.name: setPreferredMicrophoneFieldDimension
methods.description: Sets preferred microphone field dimension (zoom).

methods.name: getPortId
methods.description: Retrieves the port ID associated with the audio source.

methods.name: ~AudioSource
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: trackMaxAmplitude
methods.description: Tracks maximum amplitude from audio data.

methods.name: rampVolume
methods.description: Gradually increases volume from mute to actual level.

methods.name: queueInputBuffer_l
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for processing.

methods.name: releaseQueuedFrames_l
methods.description: Releases queued frames.

methods.name: waitOutstandingEncodingFrames_l
methods.description: Waits for encoding frames to complete.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state of the AudioSource.

methods.name: onMoreData
methods.description: Callback when more audio data is available.

methods.name: onOverrun
methods.description: Callback when buffer overrun occurs.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Initializes or reconfigures the AudioSource with given parameters.
